description: Deterministic blueprint-strategy RSS seed feeds. Always ingested by expanded_sources.py Phase 2 every weekly run, regardless of whether the Opus Phase-1 discovery run (paper_expansion_ingestor.js) succeeds. These are sites that publish EXPLICIT, reproducible rule-based daily-equity/ETF strategy blueprints (entry/exit/params + author backtests) — a higher implementation hit-rate than academic papers alone. Provenance: docs/research/strategy-blueprint-sources.md (2026-06-16). Each feed verified one-post-per-item RSS (real article title + link to original post) on 2026-06-16. NOTE: digest/aggregator hubs (Quantocracy — its RSS emits roundup stubs, not articles) and clean-URL HTML sites (TuringTrader, Quantpedia — anchors lack the .pdf/.htm extension expanded_sources.py's RX_PAPER_LINK requires) are intentionally NOT seeded here; they are steered via the Opus discovery prompt (EXPANSION_PROMPT_PREAMBLE) instead. To disable all seeds without a code change: set OPENCLAW_BLUEPRINT_SEEDS=0 in .env, or pass --no-seeds.
